subject: Edgeware pilot decision timeline & responsibilities
messages:
From: Miguel Sanchez <miguel@edgeware.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@edgeware.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — Edgeware / Redwood 

Evelyn / Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo and the deep dive today. This captured the key points we discussed on our side — please correct me if I got anything wrong.

Pain & goals (short):
- High latency and high per-query cost on current vendor for document search (avg 800ms, peaky at 1.6s).
- Need embeddings + reranking pipeline that fits into our 200ms P95 target for user-facing search.
- Strong security/compliance needs (SOC2 in 3 months; log retention + customer data segmentation).
- Goal: run a 6-week pilot that validates latency, cost, and accuracy on our 3 core datasets (support KB, product catalog, FAQ).

Decision process & timeline (what we discussed):
- Technical POC (6 weeks) -> Security review (legal + security) -> Procurement/contract (SOW) -> Exec signoff.
- Likely decision sponsor: Priya (Head of Product) + procurement for commercial terms.

Immediate asks:
1) Can Redwood provide a short Mutual Action Plan (milestones + owners + dates) that we can share internally?
2) Ballpark pilot pricing (reserved capacity vs hosted) so procurement knows ranges.
3) Any red flags re: SOC2 evidence or on-prem options?

If you can send a one-pager MPA with named owners and target dates, I will route it to procurement and security.

Best,
Miguel
Miguel Sanchez
Director, Engineering
Edgeware Technologies
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Sanchez <miguel@edgeware.com>, Priya Shah <priya@edgeware.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — Edgeware / Redwood (MPA draft + next steps)

Miguel — thanks for the clear summary, and that matches what we heard. I put together a concise Mutual Action Plan below and attached the editable MPA template (redwood-mpa-template.xlsx) and a starter SOW draft for your procurement.

Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- Week 0 (Nov 8): Kickoff & access — Edgeware provides datasets + API keys; Redwood provision test environment (owner: Miguel / Evelyn)
- Week 1-2 (Nov 9–22): Baseline metrics & integration — ingest support KB and product catalog; measure baseline latency/throughput (owner: Redwood eng, Jonas Weber)
- Week 3-4 (Nov 23–Dec 6): Optimization & quantization testing — rollout batching/kv-caching, try 4-bit quantized variant for cost tests (owner: Redwood infra)
- Week 5-6 (Dec 7–Dec 20): Evaluations & accuracy signoff — reranking evals, quality thresholds; security evidence handoff (owner: Edgeware Sec & Redwood CSM)
- By Dec 23: Pilot review & decision recommendation to execs (owner: Priya / Miguel)

Key success metrics
- P95 latency <= 250ms for search path
- Embedding similarity recall >= current baseline +/- 1% (no regression)
- Pilot cost target: <= $X per 1k queries (we will provide initial estimate)

Open items / asks from Redwood
1) Procurement contact/email to loop in for SOW & pricing (please confirm).
2) Confirmation on datasets and any PII handling rules for the pilot.
3) Nominating a technical POC on your side for weekly syncs.

Attachments: redwood-mpa-template.xlsx (editable MPA), Edgeware_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (starter SOW).

Next steps
- Miguel: confirm procurement contact + technical POC by Nov 6
- Redwood (Jonas + Evelyn): provide pilot pricing ranges and access checklist by Nov 9
- Schedule weekly 30-min syncs (proposed cadence: Tuesdays 10am PT starting Nov 9)

If that looks good, I will convert the MPA into a shared doc and route to procurement.

Thanks — looking forward to moving ahead.

—
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Evelyn / Jonas,

This looks good — thank you. Procurement contact is procurement@edgeware.com (Sara Collins will triage). Technical POC will be me for the first two weeks; Priya will step in for exec decisions.

A couple quick notes:
- We need a short price estimate for hosted vs dedicated for a 6-week pilot (ballpark ranges are fine).
- SOC2: we can accept SOC2 Type II reports; if you have a whitepaper on data segmentation, please include.

Confirming weekly sync on Tuesdays 10am PT — I’m in.

Miguel
